The '''Poln system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Poln Major]] and [[Poln Minor]].<ref name="COC" />
